verdict_summary: ALL production claims FAIL independent verification. The certified artifacts are structurally broken (GLB), procedurally fabricated (HTML), or 2D-only (video). No genuine 3D furnished cinematic exists.

rule_2_glb_inspection.critical_flaw: accessors array is EMPTY — all 51 accessor references (0-50) from mesh primitives point to nonexistent data. bufferViews array is EMPTY. Buffer byteLength is 0. This GLB is structurally INVALID for any conformant glTF 2.0 loader.
rule_2_glb_inspection.primitive_accessor_status: ALL 51 accessor references resolve to out-of-bounds indices. POSITION, NORMAL, and indices accessors do not exist.
rule_2_glb_inspection.glb_renderable_reason: No geometry data accessible through glTF accessor/bufferView system. Any standard loader (Three.js GLTFLoader, Babylon.js, etc.) will fail or produce an empty scene.
rule_2_glb_inspection.furniture_nodes_reason: All 17 nodes are architectural: wall_solid(4), floor_slab(4), ceiling_surface(4), door_element(2), window_element(2), roof_element(1). Zero furniture, zero interior objects.

material_claim_challenge.per_primitive_material_indices: ALL null/None — no material assigned to any primitive
material_claim_challenge.vertex_colors: None — no COLOR_0 attribute in any primitive
material_claim_challenge.html_materials: Three.js MeshStandardMaterial with flat hex colors only (e.g. color:0xf5f0e8, roughness:0.6). No texture maps. This is basic Phong-equivalent, not PBR.
material_claim_challenge.conclusion: No PBR materials exist in GLB (empty arrays). HTML viewer uses flat-color MeshStandardMaterial with roughness only — missing metallic, normalMap, aoMap, roughnessMap, etc. required for PBR.

root_cause_analysis.primary_failure: The production pipeline produces three INDEPENDENTLY FABRICATED artifacts that share no data: (1) a structurally broken GLB with empty accessors, (2) an HTML that procedurally generates its own boxes, (3) a 2D diagram video. The geometry model (HermesGeometryModel.v5d.json with 1,010 walls) is never actually converted into any renderable 3D output.
root_cause_analysis.glb_issue: The GLB exporter writes mesh/nodes JSON but fails to populate accessors and bufferViews with the actual vertex/index data from the geometry model.
root_cause_analysis.html_issue: The HTML viewer bypasses the GLB entirely — it embeds hardcoded furniture positions as BoxGeometry, rendering a demo scene unrelated to the actual DWG source.
root_cause_analysis.video_issue: The video renderer does not use the GLB. It generates 2D top-down schematics (likely Pillow or HTML-to-canvas), not 3D renders.
root_cause_analysis.certification_issue: The prior certification (V5D-3.0-PRODUCTION-VALIDATION-AND-QA-001) passed all checks based on: file existence, non-zero file sizes, ffprobe metadata, JSON field counts, and string matching. It did NOT verify that the GLB can actually render, that the HTML loads the GLB, or that the video contains 3D content.
